t: [2108.03879] Convergence analysis for image interpolation in terms of the cSSIM
s: March 21, 2022 - Assessing the similarity of two images is a complex task that attracts significant efforts in the image processing community. The widely used Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) addresses this problem by quantifying a perceptual structural similarity. In this paper we consider a recently introduced continuous SSIM (cSSIM), which allows one to analyze sequences of images of increasingly fine resolutions, and further extend the definition of the index to encompass the locally weighted version that is used in practice.
